purpose: Validate affected LF profile and skill packs through a deterministic, bounded, generic validation contract without absorbing runtime, assurance, database, Git-write, observability, EKB, lifecycle, or deployment responsibilities.

included: resolve affected governed packs from changed paths and declared applicability input
validate manifest and schema requirements owned by the pack contract
discover and execute the pack-local deterministic validators/validate_pack.py entrypoint when present and governed
aggregate pack-scoped PASS or FAIL with blocking codes and evidence references
excluded: runtime execution or runtime regression ownership
DeployKey use or protected branch writes
database apply, rollback, or database regression
assurance qualification or semantic quality judgment
lifecycle, deprecation, promotion, deployment, or production authorization

constraints.base_sha: 40-char git SHA when available for diff-bound validation
constraints.changed_paths: ordered or unordered list of repository-relative paths; normalization must not change semantic membership
constraints.applicable_pack_types: subset of governed pack types known to the contract; unknown values fail closed

fail_closed_conditions: affected governed pack cannot be resolved unambiguously
manifest or required schema is invalid
declared local validator is missing where required
local validator is symlinked or resolves outside its governed pack boundary
evidence cannot be bound to the exact head

ownership_invariants: PACK_VALIDATION may validate packs but must not become the owner or carrier of unrelated runtime, database, Git-write, assurance, observability, EKB, lifecycle, or deployment controls.
A control may be invoked by the pass orchestrator after PACK_VALIDATION, but its ownership and evidence remain with that control.
Pack-local validators may validate pack-owned deterministic contracts only; they must not silently become alternate orchestrators for unrelated transversal controls.
Moving a control out of Validate LF Packs requires a proven destination owner and wiring before removal from the existing carrier.
No PASS from PACK_VALIDATION grants runtime, merge, deployment, production, database-write, or Git-write authorization.
compatibility_requirements: preserve generic profile-validator discovery already relied on by governed profile packs
preserve fail-closed behavior for invalid or missing governed pack structure
do not weaken existing applicable controls while ownership is being migrated

evidence_requirements.completion_rule: The contract is defined when this document is source-readable on the exact PR head and its invariants can be consumed by the subsequent implementation PRs. This PR does not claim the workflow or validators are already compliant.
